family: MOD3: L is the set of binary strings whose number of 1s is divisible by 3, so f_n(x)=1 iff x_1+...+x_n = 0 (mod 3), for every n>=0 (f_0(empty)=1). A fixed linear-time counter mod 3 computes f_n at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the counter accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 at every integer length n=|x|>=2 in the full Li–Yang B2 model (self-contained gate-elimination proof in proof.md), so liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/(2n)>=1.
